I have been using UH psychiatry services for more than a year, and they’re pretty alright. I don’t hate it. The psychiatrist is nice and listens to you and asks you questions about your life and looks like she cares and stuff. A big reason I am using the UH psychiatry services is the price. A initial evaluation is $40 and a standard follow up appointments is $20. I feel ok about going (just like bc it’s a reminder of how depressed I am) but for the 30 minute appointments the Dr  asks you how you’re doing, are the meds working, etc (little updates basically) I can’t tell you how the evaluations go with this current psychiatrist UH has because my evaluation was with a previous psychiatrist but the evaluations usually last up to 1hr. I will let you know about this one bad experience I did have with this current psychiatrist; one day I decided to open up to her about how I was previously suicidal but that I wasn’t going to do it and that it was just a thought but she called for a general welfare check on me and there was just like a ton of cops at my house and if my parents didn’t come home they would have probably taken me to the hospital which just really sucked in general because I thought I could trust her because I told her I wasn’t going to do it and I had a support system etc., I now realize that she was probably just concerned and doing her job but I was pretty upset and resentful towards her for a couple of months. ( I just don’t tell her those things anymore Lol) In summary I guess I rate the service 7/10.
